description: [roadmap S3.6] Surface_blit3's GDI StretchBlt cases are modelled as nearest-pixel magnification (destination column x2 + i reads source column x + i * w / w2, rows likewise) and a source rectangle on the destination surface is read from a copy taken before the first write. No pinned checkpoint whose other causes are all settled shows a magnified rectangle or a self-overlapping copy (P4_golferOne's magnifier and P5_zoom's centre 400 x 300 lie under the golfer info panel or the full-screen zoom, whose other drawing is S2's), so neither rule is confirmed by a frame yet; a shrink is reported (no call site shrinks). Controls: one row short changes no frame of cov_a_golfer / cov_b_shots / cov_a_keys; one column right changes 4 pixels of cov_b_shots end, over terrain the port does not draw (both blind).
needed: A pinned checkpoint with the zoom view or the golfer magnifier once S2's dialogs are in the frame.

description: [roadmap S3.6] Sprite::drawG's shade table argument (Surface_blit2 / Surface_drawScaled2 / drawScaledSprite421b90) names g_halfBrightLut or g_color16Lut by value; both are heap pointers the port's GameState holds as 0 (pointer class), so a value equal to both is taken as the half-bright table. Every port call site of these drops passes the g_halfBrightLut word (tick_frame.inc, tick_panels.inc), so the choice is not decided by the value at run time but by the call sites. Its control (block 1 always) is blind on the opaque-pixel gate: shaded pixels are blends over the background.
needed: A pointer-class value for the two tables in the GameState, or the call sites' table recorded per drop.

description: [roadmap S3.6] A SpriteRef the HUD draws with no modelled cut is a no-op (the wrappers return 7 on a NULL handle +4). port/test/test_gfx_hud.py checks every such key of a cov_a_build boot against the handle word of the original's records in every segment start image of the scenario: all NULL. Keys a scenario without segments draws are not checked.
needed: The check over more scenarios as their segments exist.

description: [roadmap S3.6] The hover tips of the HUD panels are reported as `tooltip:` and not drawn: showInfoCursorPanel's tool tip (drawFrameR3 box, name in g_font51b360, rating sprite, story text through storyText 0x0045b660 and the wrapped text 0x0045b0d0) and slot tip (drawMapLine bar and text), drawTerrainToolbar's and drawAmenitiesPanel's dwell tips and the hovered building row (drawPanelBackdrop / drawMapLine). The family keeps the original's dwell counter (g_panelState + 4 / g_ui_5aa554) itself because the port's layout functions do not write it. The lead assigned the tips to S3.7 (tooltips are in S3.7's scope, 2026-10-25); the drawMapLine bars they draw are S3.8's line passes.

[roadmap S3.6] The HUD's sprite-queue draws are reported as `addSprite:` and not drawn: showInfoCursorPanel's hole flag (cellAt + addSprite when the hole record's +0x18 is 0) and drawAmenityRow's amenities. They are drawn by drawQueuedSprite with the scene (S3.5); on cov_a_golfer the flag is the only bad pixel group of bottom_panel (202 px). The lead assigned both to S3.5 (2026-10-25).

[roadmap S3.6] Widget_writePixel's frame oracle: no pinned reference holds a decoration pixel of mainLoop's type-0x11 tiles (ML+0x203f) that a terrain-less port frame can isolate (they lie over terrain, S3.2). The body is judged by unit tests (bounds, low word) and its RED control there; Widget_fillRect by the tool window separator of cov_a_keys k_render_dot / k_render_slash.
needed: A frame with terrain drawn (S3.2 merged) to compare the decoration pixels.

description: [roadmap S3.6] Widget_fillRect is registered by the pixel family here and by S2.8's reports / S2.9's dialogs families (U-1278, S2.13 keeps the reports body: the same jgld line16 with Surface_box's clip). When both are in one tree gfx.check reports the duplicate; the merge deletes the pixel family's entry (6_merge.md section 2) and test_gfx_pixel.py switches its fillRect controls to the reports body. The lead confirmed the rule (2026-10-25): S2's body wins, a primitive both sections need is S2's.
needed: The integrator applies 6_merge.md section 2 when S2's family is in the tree.

description: [roadmap S3.6] Sprite::drawB under a display scale (jgld draw16_1001bc40) is modelled for positive scales and for x-mirrored scaled rectangles (nx < 0, |nx| != den): rectangle (x + (int)fx, y + (int)fy, (int)(w fx), (int)(h fy)) with fx = (float)|nx| / den, source column (sx (offX + j)) >> 16 with sx = (den << 16) / |nx| (w - 1 - that when mirrored). The row step reads the dword before or at the pointer [0x10122e20] by the fraction's carry; their initial values 0x1012854c / 0x10128550 (jgld .data) make that pair (sy >> 16) rows and one row more. The unscaled mirrored body (it starts at the left offset and decrements) and ny < 0 are reported. The callers are mainLoop's thought bubble and head over a golfer (scale (1, 1, 2) and (-1, 1, 2)); they draw between checkpoints, so no judged frame holds one and the control (one source column right) is blind.
needed: A frame that reaches the reported bodies.

description: [roadmap S3.6] drawAmenitiesPanel's drawing is judged on cov_a_build's amenities / amen_* / bldg_* checkpoints (0 opaque HUD pixels differ). Which of its five rows (M = 1, 4, 0x13, 2, 0x10) those checkpoints reach is not measured; the M == 4 row needs g_amenityUnlockMask set.
needed: A checkpoint with those amenity tools open.

description: [roadmap S3.6] The gate's opaque-pixel measure cannot see a HUD panel the port does not draw at all (no pixel is opaque there, so none differs): before edit 7 the bottom panel's modes 2..4 (drawEmployeeViewPanel, drawGolferActionPanel, drawEmployeeDetailPanel) drew nothing and reported nothing. Edit 7 hands all three to the backend; drawGolferActionPanel and drawMatchScoreboard are drawn, the golfer list (drawEmployeeViewPanel 0x00435760) and the detail panel (drawEmployeeDetailPanel 0x00436e50) are reported as this step's gaps. Other HUD drawing reached only through layout functions with no draw call would be invisible the same way.
needed: The two panels' drawing; a per-region coverage check (opaque pixels against the region's area) for the section gate.
